name: letter-cascade
description: A 3D split-flap word where each glyph tilts back while its echo flips up in a staggered spring wave.
purpose: Adds a kinetic wordmark or hover label when a line of text should feel mechanical and dimensional without leaving the token set.
bestFor: hover or click micro-copy on marketing heroes
demo labels that need a split-flap cascade
avoidFor: critical form labels that must stay still
